name: A Hush Falls Over the World
descr:
**Archetype** [World Rouser](/archetype/world-rouser-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-396)

**Prerequisites**
[World Rouser Dedication](/feat/world-rouser-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9376)

**Requirements**
Your waking world is active.

---

Sound is absorbed in your waking world, covering everything in a shroud of quiet until the start of your next turn. Creatures in your waking world become hidden to [imprecise hearing](/rule/imprecise-senses-rules-2407) or [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) to [precise hearing](/rule/precise-senses-rules-2406). A creature in your waking world attempting to use spell or effect with the [auditory](/trait/auditory) or [sonic](/trait/sonic) trait must succeed at a DC 4 [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278); on a failure, the spell or effect is [disrupted](/rule/disrupted-and-lost-spells-rules-2236). Anytime a creature in the area is affected by an auditory or sonic effect, they must attempt a DC 16 flat check. On a success, they are not affected by the auditory or sonic effect, though they still may be affected by other aspects of an ability (for example, a creature hit by a weapon with a [_thundering_](/item/thundering-gm-core) rune would not take sonic damage but would still take the normal damage from the weapon).

name: Aether Beam
descr:
**Archetype** [Living Nexus](/archetype/living-nexus-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-392)

**Prerequisites**
[Living Nexus Dedication](/feat/living-nexus-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9338)

**Requirements**

---

You can open your internal nexus, unleashing a destructive beam of magical energy that emanates from your hand, eyes, or chest. You fire a beam that deals 6d6 force damage in a 60- foot [line](/rule/line-rules-2388) and pushes back anyone who stands within. Each creature in the area must attempt a [basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) Reflex save against your nexus DC. A creature that fails is also pushed back 10 feet (20 feet on a critical failure). The damage increases by 2d6 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter. You are no longer overflowing.

name: Afterimage
descr:
**Archetype** [Veil Dancer](/archetype/veil-dancer-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-395)

**Prerequisites**
[Veil Dancer Dedication](/feat/veil-dancer-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9363)

**Trigger**
You use an action or cast a spell with the [teleportation](/trait/teleportation) trait.

---

You leave behind an afterimage of yourself in your previous square. This afterimage looks like you and can perform simple behaviors to make the deception more plausible but otherwise cannot move or take actions. A creature can distinguish between you and your afterimage easily. Your afterimage automatically fails all checks and DCs and is destroyed if it would take any damage; otherwise, it lasts for 1 minute. Whenever you take the [Step](/action/step-player-core) action, you can instead teleport to an afterimage instead. If you do, the action gains the teleportation trait, and the afterimage you teleport to is destroyed.

name: All Returns to Slumber
descr:
**Archetype** [World Rouser](/archetype/world-rouser-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-396)

**Prerequisites**
[World Rouser Dedication](/feat/world-rouser-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9376)

**Requirements**
Your waking world is active.

---

Your waking world returns to slumber, and lays the peace of deep sleep on all within it. You [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) your waking world, and all creatures in the area must attempt a Will save against your world rouser DC. [Animals](/trait/animal), [beasts](/trait/beast), and [plants](/trait/plant) native to this world treat the result of their save as one degree worse. Creatures in the area then become temporarily immune to this ability for 1 hour.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature can’t use reactions for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature is also [slowed](/condition/slowed-player-core) 1.

---

Your intuitive understanding of magic allows you to read the energy of a spell in the air. You gain the Analyze Magic spellshift.

**Spellshift—Analyze Magic** Once you’ve homed in on a spell or magical effect, you can study its unique magical signature to immediately understand exactly what it does.

**Critical Success** You learn information about the spell or effect as if you had critically succeeded at a skill check to [Identify Magic](/action/identify-magic-player-core) using the appropriate skill for its magical tradition.

**Success** You learn information about the spell or effect as if you had succeeded at a skill check to Identify Magic using the appropriate skill for its magical tradition.

name: Anatomical Quartering
descr:
---

You briefly separate into four forms that share your space. One is made of blood, one of bones, one of flesh, and one of spirit. Make up to four [Strikes](/action/strike-player-core), each against a different target. All physical damage from the final Strike instead becomes [spirit](/trait/spirit) damage. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you don’t increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

name: Annihilating Compound Invocation
descr:
---

Each tradition of magic holds sway over two of the four essences that make up all of creation, and so by invoking runes from each tradition at once, you can pull from the four corners of magic to unravel anything. You [invoke four runes](/action/invoke-rune-impossible-magic-action-action-4265) of your choice, each of which must be from a different tradition of magic. In addition to the runes’ normal effects, one creature within 30 feet of all invoked runes must attempt a [basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) Fortitude saving throw, taking 10d4 force damage on a failure as destructive magical reverberations clash in their body. If reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage or by the damage of any of the runes invoked, the creature’s body is torn apart into glowing script that describes the creature to the smallest detail, leaving no remains as the letters fade. The creature’s gear is unharmed.

name: Arcane Fists
descr:
---

Your physical training encompasses unarmed combat forms. The damage die for your fist changes to 1d6 instead of 1d4. You don’t take the normal –2 circumstance penalty when making a lethal attack with your fist or any other unarmed attacks. Your unarmed attacks gain the [arcane](/trait/arcane) trait, making them magical. At 5th level, you also gain the [critical specialization](/rule/critical-specialization-rules-2203) effects of unarmed attacks in the brawling group and weapons in the brawling group, using your spell DC instead of class DC.

name: Arcane Shroud
descr:
**Prerequisites**
[Arcane Cascade](/action/arcane-cascade-impossible-magic-action-action-4261)

---

Your magic has a powerful aftereffect, briefly granting you a certain spell. When you take this feat, choose three of [_false vitality_](/spell/false-vitality-player-core), [_fleet step_](/spell/fleet-step-player-core), [_invisibility_](/spell/invisibility-player-core), [_mountain resilience_](/spell/mountain-resilience-player-core), [_resist energy_](/spell/resist-energy-player-core), and [_see the unseen_](/spell/see-the-unseen-player-core).

When you use Arcane Cascade, choose one of the spells you selected with this feat. You’re affected by this aftereffect spell until the end of your next turn, though it ends early if the stance ends or another circumstance ends it (such as if you take a [hostile action](/rule/hostile-actions-rules-2251) while affected by _invisibility_). If you’re 18th level or higher, a _false vitality_ or _resist energy_ you get from Arcane Shroud is heightened to 4th rank.

**Special** You can select this feat a second time to add the remaining spells to your set of choices.

name: Astral Compound Invocation
descr:
---

Invoking runes from two schools of magic that both manipulate the intangible realm of thought results in waves of mental interference that stagger your foes. You [Invoke two Runes](/action/invoke-rune-impossible-magic-action-action-4265); one must be an [arcane](/trait/arcane) rune, and one must be an [occult](/trait/occult) rune. In addition to the runes’ normal effects, one creature within 30 feet of both invoked runes must attempt a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected by the compound invocation.

**Success** The target is [stupefied](/condition/stupefied-player-core) 1 until the end of your next turn.

**Failure** The target is stupefied 2 until the end of your next turn.

**Critical Failure** The target is stupefied 3 until the end of your next turn.

name: Backup Runic Enhancement
descr:
**Prerequisites**
Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion

---

While you are not a spellcaster, you have a working knowledge of the most fundamental runic magic. You can cast the [_sigil_](/spell/sigil-player-core) cantrip as an [innate spell](/rule/innate-spells-rules-2232) at will. In addition, choose either [_runic body_](/spell/runic-body-player-core) or [_runic weapon_](/spell/runic-weapon-player-core). You can cast this spell once per day as an innate spell. The rank of these spells is equal to half your level, rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least trained in the related skill (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, and Religion for [divine](/trait/divine)).

name: Basic Captivator Spellcasting
descr:
**Archetype** [Captivator](/archetype/captivator-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-390)

**Prerequisites**
[Captivator Dedication](/feat/captivator-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9315)

---

Your innate ability to fascinate others develops into full‑fledged spellcasting. This spellcasting comes naturally and instinctively to you rather than as a product of training. Choose a 1st-rank [occult](/trait/occult) spell that has the [illusion](/trait/illusion) or [mental](/trait/mental) trait. You can cast this spell as an [innate occult spell](/rule/innate-spells-rules-2901). At 6th level, you gain a 2nd-rank occult spell, and at 8th level you gain a 3rd-rank occult spell. name: Beckoning Dirge
descr:
**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
puppeteer fatal method

---

Your dirge beckons, overflowing into a thrall within 60 feet. This turn, you can [Cast one Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) that’s in your dirge without spending a spell slot or even having it prepared. The maximum rank of this spell is 1 rank lower than your highest-rank necromancer spell slot. The chosen thrall becomes the point of origin for your spell, and you calculate range and cover from its space instead of yours. The thrall is then destroyed.

---

Additionally, you [ignore natural difficult terrain](/rule/ignore-difficult-terrain-rules-2367) and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to [Escape](/action/escape-player-core) attempts. ---

Your eidolon flies into a frenzy. While in the frenzy, your eidolon is affected by [_boost eidolon_](/spell/boost-eidolon-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2913) and gains [temporary HP](/rule/temporary-hit-points-rules-2321) equal to your level, but takes a –1 penalty to AC. name: Bodily Disintegration
descr:
**Frequency**
once per hour

---

You have such complete control of your component atoms that you can momentarily separate them far enough apart for you to pass through solid material. You focus on your physical body and will the parts of it to disassemble momentarily. You Stride. You can pass through creatures and tiny cracks during this movement. You cannot pass through solid walls or magical boundaries such as a [_wall of force_](/spell/wall-of-force-player-core). If you haven’t completely passed through a creature or object by the end of your movement, you take 4d6 bludgeoning damage and are shunted to the nearest spot that you can occupy.

**Enhancement** When you use Bodily Disintegration, you can move through solid walls and delay fully reassembling your body, causing you to become [concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) until the start of your next turn.

name: Bone Speaker
descr:
---

To truly understand the mechanical advantages of an undead skeleton, you must understand how it functioned in life. You can [Recall Knowledge](/action/recall-knowledge-player-core) on living creatures with an internal or external skeleton using Undead Lore. If you do, you can learn only information pertaining to the biology of a creature—not any learned abilities or abilities granted by items.

Additionally, you can perform a forensic examination on a corpse using Undead Lore instead of Medicine if the corpse came from a creature with a skeleton.

name: By Your Name
descr:
**Frequency**
once per hour

**Requirements**
You must know the target’s name.

---

In a moment of inspiration, you understand the target perfectly, allowing you to craft a rune that draws effects to the target by their very name. Attempt a Crafting check against a [standard DC](/rule/level-based-dcs-rules-2629) of the target creature’s level. Regardless of the outcome, you can’t attempt to use By Your Name against the target again for 24 hours.

**Critical Success** You understand the target’s runic name and temporarily learn how to write their name as a special diacritic rune. This diacritic rune magnifies the effects of the base rune when targeting the named creature. When the rune is invoked, the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their saving throw against the effects of the base rune, and if the base rune deals damage, it gains a status bonus to its damage equal to half your level. The inspiration used to understand this diacritic rune fades quickly, and you forget how to use the diacritic rune after 1 minute.

**Success** As critical success, but the rune doesn’t grant a bonus to damage.

name: Capture Magic
descr:
**Prerequisites**
[Arcane Cascade](/action/arcane-cascade-impossible-magic-action-action-4261)

**Trigger**
You succeed at your save against an enemy’s harmful spell, or an enemy fails a spell attack roll against you from a harmful spell.

---

When you resist a spell, you capture some of its magic for your own use. You enter your Arcane Cascade stance, using the triggering spell to determine what damage type your Arcane Cascade deals. Alternatively, if you’re already in Arcane Cascade, you can instead amplify its effects temporarily. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 status bonus to the extra damage and resistance you gain from your Arcane Cascade.

name: Cascading Ray
descr:
**Prerequisites**
[Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260)

**Requirements**
Your last action was a successful Spellstrike, and the spell you cast dealt energy damage ([acid](/trait/acid), [cold](/trait/cold), [electricity](/trait/electricity), [fire](/trait/fire), [force](/trait/force), [sonic](/trait/sonic), [vitality](/trait/vitality), or [void](/trait/void)).

---

Magical energy spills out to extend beyond the creature you struck. The flowing energy forms a ray with a range of 120 feet originating from the creature you damaged. You can’t target any of the creatures you damaged with your Spellstrike with the ray. Make a spell attack against the new target’s AC, at the same multiple attack penalty as the Strike. On a hit, the target of the ray takes 1d4 damage per spell rank of the spell you used for Spellstrike, or 1d8 damage per rank if you cast the spell from a spell slot. The ray uses the same damage type as the spell dealt (choose one if it dealt more than one type of damage). This ray has the [attack](/trait/attack) trait, the tradition trait of the original spell, and the trait matching the damage type.

name: Chain of Words
descr:
**Frequency**
once pr 10 minutes

---

You see the thin lines of magic between your creations, and you can exploit that connection with a small shift of power from one rune to another. You [Invoke two Runes](/action/invoke-rune-impossible-magic-action-action-4265) within 60 feet. In addition to the runes’ normal effects, a chain of glowing script flows between them, dealing 5d6 force damage to all creatures in a straight [line](/rule/line-rules-2388) between them with a [basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) Reflex saving throw; creatures bearing the invoked runes are not in the area of this line. A creature who critically fails its save is also [immobilized](/condition/immobilized-player-core) for 1 round or until it [Escapes](/action/escape-player-core), as the runes seal its movements. The DC to Escape is your class DC.

At 12th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

name: Clashing Compound Invocation
descr:
---

As you invoke runes from disparate traditions of magic, their diametrically opposed effects repel each other in a destructive backlash. You [Invoke two Runes](/action/invoke-rune-impossible-magic-action-action-4265), which must be from opposed traditions of magic; either 1 [arcane](/trait/arcane) and 1 [divine](/trait/divine) rune, or 1 [occult](/trait/occult) and 1 [primal](/trait/primal) rune. In addition to the runes’ normal effects, one creature within 30 feet of both invoked runes must also attempt a Fortitude saving throw as destructive magical harmonics clash.

**Success** The target is [sickened](/condition/sickened-player-core) 1, but if it spends a single action attempting to recover, it automatically succeeds.

**Failure** The target is sickened 1.

**Critical Failure** The target is sickened 2.

name: Come in From the Wilderness
descr:
**Archetype** [World Rouser](/archetype/world-rouser-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-396)

**Prerequisites**
[World Rouser Dedication](/feat/world-rouser-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9376)

**Requirements**
Your waking world is active.

---

A willing ally on the ground in your waking world is swaddled in earth. For each source of [persistent damage](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core) it is taking, the creature can immediately attempt a [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278) to recover, with the DC reduction from appropriate assistance. While swallowed, the creature becomes [paralyzed](/condition/paralyzed-player-core) and cannot be targeted or affected by any new effects (ongoing effects, such as [afflictions](/rule/afflictions-rules-2765) or persistent damage, continue to affect it as normal). At the start of your next turn, the creature regains 6d8 Hit Points and emerges in its previous location. If another creature is in that location, it is pushed to the nearest available space. The target creature then becomes temporarily immune to this ability until your next daily preparations.

descr:

---

Your innate power can shut down other magic. You gain the [Dismantle](/spell/dismantle-player-core-2) Spell spellshift.

**Spellshift—Dismantle Spell** You attempt to [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-2250) a spell or at least suppress its effect for a time.

**Critical Success** The spell is counteracted if its rank is no more than 1 higher than half your level rounded up.

**Success** The effects of the spell are suppressed until the start of your next turn. If the spell has a duration that is measured in rounds, its duration is extended by 1 round. If the spell does not have a duration, it targets the same creature or area as though it had just been cast at the start of your next turn.

name: Elemental Revision
descr:

You can also revise the greater version of any of the above runes into the greater version of any other rune on the list (for instance, _greater corrosive_ into _greater frost_). The revision lasts for 1 minute before the rune’s original magic reasserts itself.

**Spellshift—Elemental Substitution** Raw elemental energy is the fuel powering some of the most iconic spells of destruction ever devised, and you’ve discovered a method for realigning the magical pathways through which that energy flows into the material world.

**Critical Success** If the targeted spell inflicts [acid](/trait/acid), [cold](/trait/cold), [electricity](/trait/electricity), [fire](/trait/fire), or [sonic](/trait/sonic) damage, you change its damage type to your choice of one of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. If the effect has a duration, it inflicts damage of its new type for 1 minute, then returns to normal.

**Spellshift—Elemental Substitution** Raw elemental energy is the fuel powering some of the most iconic spells of destruction ever devised, and you’ve discovered a method for realigning the magical pathways through which that energy flows into the material world.

**Critical Success** If the targeted spell inflicts acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, you change its damage type to your choice of one of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. If the effect has a duration, it inflicts damage of its new type for 1 minute, then returns to normal.

**Success** As critical success, except if the effect has a duration, it inflicts damage of its new type until the beginning of your next turn, then returns to normal.

If you do, even before your first turn in a combat encounter, that cantrip is active as if you had cast it on your previous turn.

name: Expansive Spellstrike
descr:
**Prerequisites**
[Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260)

---

You can blast the energy of a spell out around the target of your attack. When you Spellstrike with a spell that has an area of a [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385), [cone](/rule/cone-rules-2386), or [line](/rule/line-rules-2388), the spell creates an area instead of affecting only the target. The target must be in the area, and Expansive Spellstrike has no effect if your spell was disrupted (such as if you critically fail your [Strike](/action/strike-player-core)). A burst is centered on any corner you choose of the target’s square (or the corner of any square in its space for a Large or larger creature). A cone or line emits from you and must include the target; if you’re not adjacent to the target (using a [reach](/trait/reach) weapon or starlit span, for example), choose any square adjacent to the target as the source. The spell affects all creatures in the area as normal, but the Strike still targets only one creature.

name: Exploding Bullet
descr:

**Requirements**

---

You load your gun with a bullet forged of magic instead of matter, barely contained in an arcane shell. [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) to [reload](/rule/reload-rules-2196) your firearm, creating an arcane round made from your choice of [fire](/trait/fire) or [sonic](/trait/sonic) energy. When you shoot this round, the Strike gains the [arcane](/trait/arcane) trait and the corresponding energy trait. The firearm gains the scatter 5 feet trait, or gains a +1 status bonus to its splash damage if it already has the scatter trait. The scatter trait’s splash damage uses the energy type you chose. The bullet disappears if not fired by the end of your next turn.

If your firearm takes more than 1 action to reload, you need to use Exploding Bullet for all the actions needed to reload it to get the benefits.

**Special** When you use volatile spark’s Reloading Cascade action, you can use Exploding Bullet instead of an Interact action to reload a firearm.

You gain the [Additional Lore](/feat/additional-lore-player-core) feat for a topic the spirit knew in life, usually Warfare Lore.

If you would fall [unconscious](/condition/unconscious-player-core), you don’t fall [prone](/condition/prone-player-core) or drop any items. Instead, your heroic spirit takes control of your body, allowing you to [perform](/action/perform-player-core) actions as if you were still conscious. If you would die, your heroic spirit puppets your corpse for up to 1 minute after your death or until your body is destroyed. While dead, you are an undead object, granting you [immunities](/rule/immunities-rules-1609) to [bleed](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core), [death effects](/rule/death-effects-rules-2331), [disease](/trait/disease), [healing](/trait/healing), [nonlethal attacks](/rule/nonlethal-attacks-rules-2311), [poison](/trait/poison), and [void](/trait/void), as well as the [doomed](/condition/doomed-player-core), [drained](/condition/drained-player-core), [fatigued](/condition/fatigued-player-core), [sickened](/condition/sickened-player-core), and unconscious conditions. As an object, you have 200 Hit Points and a [Broken](/condition/broken-player-core) Threshold of 100 Hit Points. While broken, you are [slowed](/condition/slowed-player-core) 1. If you are destroyed, your body must be mended before you can be brought back to life. A creature can spend 8 hours to attempt a DC 45 Crafting check, mending your body on a success. Alternatively, powerful magic such as the [_remake_](/spell/remake-player-core) spell or the [_wish_](/ritual/wish-player-core) ritual can also be used to mend your body.

name: Forge New Word
descr:
---

At the pinnacle of your art, you have forged a new great rune of power, a new ideal expression or utterance to be added to the craft. You create a rune and add it to your runic repertoire. When you gain this feat, choose a spell of 4th rank or lower. It must be common, or you must otherwise have access to it. The spell must take 1 or 2 actions to cast. You can choose a variable action spell, deciding when you create the rune whether the rune uses the 1-action or 2-action version of the spell. Name your rune. This rune has the [unique](/trait/unique) trait and a [magical](/trait/magical) trait of your choosing ([arcane](/trait/arcane), [divine](/trait/divine), [occult](/trait/occult), or [primal](/trait/primal)).

This rune can be drawn on a creature or object, regardless of what the spell can target. When invoked, this rune has the effect of the chosen spell. The rune-bearer is the point of origin for the spell’s effect; calculate range and cover from its space. If the spell has targets, you decide who or what the spell targets, and the rune-bearer is a possible target if your chosen spell can target it. If the spell can affect only you (such as [_translocate_](/spell/translocate-player-core)), invoking it affects only you, and has no effect if the rune is drawn anywhere other than on you. If the spell requires a spell attack roll, use your class DC – 10 in place of the spell attack modifier. If your chosen spell has a duration and that duration is longer than 1 minute, the invoked rune’s duration is 1 minute instead.

name: Fused Staff
descr:
---

You can use your arcane prowess to fuse a magical staff into a weapon during your daily preparations or as a 10-minute activity with the [manipulate](/trait/manipulate) trait. The fusion lasts until you fuse the staff again or the weapon is out of your possession for 24 hours. The fused item has the staff’s activations and other benefits, and it can be used to cast spells if you prepare it. The staff and the weapon share their [fundamental runes](/rule/fundamental-runes-rules-3167), using whichever _weapon potency_ and whichever [_striking_](/item/striking-gm-core) rune is higher level. If the staff has [property runes](/rule/property-runes-rules-3168), they’re suppressed while it’s fused.

The item’s fused abilities work for you alone. A different wielder can use the weapon normally, but they don’t get the benefit of the shared runes and can’t use the staff’s spells or abilities.

name: Hedge Mage Dedication
descr:
**Archetype** [Hedge Mage](/archetype/hedge-mage-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-391)

**Prerequisites**
Intelligence +2 or Wisdom +2

---

The Universe is your laboratory and altar, and the world your workshop and study. Grounding your theoretical studies in honest labor, you work with the mundane to draw forth their hidden magic. When you take this dedication, choose Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion. You become trained in that skill, or you become expert if you were already trained. You also gain a keepsake that helps your magical studies; this keepsake is something that has perhaps been handed down to you but to which you’ve contributed a few personal touches, though it can be anything appropriate to your personal magical style. Sample keepsakes include a folio or binder of magical observations, a walking stick with mnemonic grooves, a bracelet of assorted charms and baubles, or a planchette carved into shape of a coffin. If it’s destroyed or lost, you can create a new keepsake with 1 day of downtime.

You gain the [Cast a Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) activity. You’re trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for hedge mage archetype spells is your choice of Intelligence or Wisdom, and they are hedge mage spells of a tradition associated with the skill chosen for this dedication (arcane for Arcana, primal for Nature, occult for Occultism, and divine for Religion).

Your keepsake holds 4 common cantrips of your choice from your appropriate tradition. You prepare spells each day by meditating with your keepsake. You can prepare two cantrips from your keepsake each day. You can only add cantrips to your keepsake with the [Learn a Spell](/action/learn-a-spell-player-core) activity or by other similar means.

The stones each appear in an unoccupied 5-foot space within 30 feet of you and within 15 feet of each other. When you raise the henge gate, choose one rune that can be drawn on a creature to carve into the stones. If you or an ally makes a successful ranged Strike using physical ammunition and that attack passes through the henge gate, the ammunition gains that rune in flight and automatically traces it on the target. The henge gate lasts for 1 minute.

name: Hobbling Criticals
descr:
---

Your eidolon’s unarmed attacks batter your foes into submission, hampering their movement. Whenever your eidolon gets a critical hit with one of their unarmed Strikes, the target must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC after taking the damage. This is a [critical specialization](/rule/critical-specialization-rules-2203) effect.

**Critical Success** The target takes no additional effect.

**Success** The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

**Failure** The target is [slowed](/condition/slowed-player-core) 1 and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target is slowed 2 and takes a –15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

name: Incriminating Spell
descr:
---

You can attempt to blame someone else for your attempt to modify a target’s mind. If the next action you use is to [Cast a Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) with the [mental](/trait/mental) trait, choose a creature within 60 feet that the target can sense. The target will think that creature, instead of you, attempted to alter its mind when it succeeds at its save. If the target attempts to [Sense Motive](/action/sense-motive-player-core) on either you or the incriminated creature, they must compare the results to your spell DC instead of the target’s Deception DC. If the incriminated creature is obviously incapable of using magic, the target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their [perception](/rule/perception-rules-2040) check to Sense Motive.

name: Knockback Spell
descr:
---

You imbue your spells with magical force to knock creatures back. If the next action you use is to [Cast a Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) that has an area of a [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385), [cone](/rule/cone-rules-2386), [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387), or [line](/rule/line-rules-2388); has no duration; and requires creatures to attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save, the spell unleashes a forceful blast that pushes creatures away, in addition to its other effects. Each creature that failed its save against the spell is pushed 5 feet, and those who critically failed are pushed 10 feet. If the spell is a cone, emanation, or a line, you push the creature away from yourself. If the spell is a burst, you push the creature away from the center of the burst.

name: Living Nexus Dedication
descr:
**Archetype** [Living Nexus](/archetype/living-nexus-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-392)

**Prerequisites**
trained in martial weapons; Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion

---

Whether through happenstance or hours of rigorous training, you have discovered within yourself the ability to breathe in the magic around you.

You have an invisible, internal nexus of energy and have learned how to control your absorption of others’ magical energy and store it in this internal nexus. You gain the Absorb Magic reaction and the Overflowing Blade action. The DC for an ability gained via this archetype is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your nexus DC.

**Absorb Magic** **Reaction** ([concentrate](/trait/concentrate), [magical](/trait/magical)) **Requirements** You are not overflowing; **Trigger** Another creature within 30 feet [Casts a Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) or uses an action, activity, or reaction with the [arcane](/trait/arcane), [divine](/trait/divine), magical, [occult](/trait/occult), or [primal](/trait/primal) trait; **Effect** You breathe in a small fraction of the magic produced by the triggering effect, storing it in your internal nexus. You become overflowing. You remain overflowing for up to 1 minute before the stored magical energy fades. While overflowing, you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against effects with the arcane, divine, magical, occult, and primal traits. This bonus becomes +2 at 15th level.

**Overflowing Blade** **Single Action** (concentrate, [force](/trait/force), magical) **Requirements** You are overflowing; **Effect** You conduct the magic in your internal nexus to coat your weapon or unarmed strike, empowering it with magical energy for a devastating attack. Make a melee [Strike](/action/strike-player-core). If the Strike hits, you deal an additional 1d4 force damage. At 10th level, the additional damage increases to 2d4 force damage. At 18th level, the additional damage increases to 3d4 force damage. You are no longer overflowing.

## Living Nexus Dedication leads to...

[Aether Beam](/feat/aether-beam-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9345), [Aether Blast](/feat/aether-blast-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9340), [Flexible Nexus](/feat/flexible-nexus-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9342), [Harness Natural Magic](/feat/harness-natural-magic-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9343), [Healing Nexus](/feat/healing-nexus-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9346), [Inspired Memory](/feat/inspired-memory-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9339), [Null Field](/feat/null-field-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9347), [Quick Absorption](/feat/quick-absorption-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9349), [Steal Magic's Breath](/feat/steal-magic-s-breath-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9348), [Surging Smash](/feat/surging-smash-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9344), [The Taste of Magic](/feat/the-taste-of-magic-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9341)

**Overflowing Blade** **Single Action** (concentrate, force, magical) **Requirements** You are overflowing; **Effect** You conduct the magic in your internal nexus to coat your weapon or unarmed strike, empowering it with magical energy for a devastating attack. Make a melee Strike. If the Strike hits, you deal an additional 1d4 force damage. At 10th level, the additional damage increases to 2d4 force damage. At 18th level, the additional damage increases to 3d4 force damage. You are no longer overflowing.

name: Look Again
descr:
**Archetype** [Captivator](/archetype/captivator-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-390)

**Prerequisites**
[Captivator Dedication](/feat/captivator-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9315)

---

If your charms or illusions fail to ensnare the minds of others, you can cast them again. If your next action is to cast an [innate spell](/rule/innate-spells-rules-2232) with either the [illusion](/trait/illusion) or [mental](/trait/mental) trait and it fails to affect any targets, you do not lose the spell. You must use the same number of actions to recast the same spell on your following turn; if you can’t, or choose not to, you lose the spell. After this second casting, you lose the spell whether it affected any targets or not, and you can’t use Look Again until your next daily preparations. Look Again works only with spells that can affect creatures or require a target and doesn’t do anything if you cast the spell with no targets or creatures in the area.

descr:

Your eidolon makes a melee [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) against a creature, and then you cast a 1- or 2-action cantrip targeting the same creature. If your eidolon’s Strike hits, the creature is [off-guard](/condition/off-guard-player-core) against your spell (if it requires a spell attack roll) or takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its save against your spell (if it requires a saving throw). name: Meld Into Eidolon
descr:
---

Your physical form can combine with that of your eidolon. You Manifest your Eidolon, but instead of summoning them into an adjacent open space, you become them. You can also Meld into Eidolon while your eidolon is manifested in an adjacent space. While Manifested in this way, you use your eidolon’s statistics, and you can’t act except to direct the eidolon to use Manifest an Eidolon to unmanifest themself. Your eidolon is affected by [_boost eidolon_](/spell/boost-eidolon-impossible-magic-spell-spell-2913) while Manifested in this way.

Since you can’t act, you can’t cast spells, activate or benefit from magic items that normally benefit you and not your eidolon, [perform](/action/perform-player-core) actions that have the [tandem](/trait/tandem) trait, or use other abilities that require you, and not the eidolon, to act. You can’t be separately targeted while you are melded into the eidolon. When you reach 0 HP, your eidolon unmanifests, leaving your body behind, [unconscious](/condition/unconscious-player-core) and [dying](/condition/dying-player-core).

You can cast spells like a necromancer, gaining a dirge with four common occult cantrips of your choice. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two cantrips each day from your dirge. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for necromancer archetype spells is Intelligence, and they are occult necromancer spells. You become trained in Occultism; if you were already trained in Occultism, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

Once per turn you can use a single action to create a single thrall within 30 feet. This action has the concentrate, manipulate, necromancer, occult, and thrall traits. You can use the Command a Thrall action as described in the thrall trait.

name: Necromantic Lifesense
descr:
---

Your connection to life and death allows you to sense the life force of a creature with a glance. You gain lifesense as an [imprecise sense](/rule/imprecise-senses-rules-2407) with a range of 30 feet. This allows you to sense the life force of living and [undead](/trait/undead) creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

Additionally, you know the current Hit Points and [temporary Hit Points](/rule/temporary-hit-points-rules-2321) of any living or undead creature you can see within 30 feet.

name: Ocular Flesh
descr:
---

You create a fleshy eyeball that is the size of a marble. You can take a single action, which has the [concentrate](/trait/concentrate) trait, to look through any of your eyeballs until the start of your next turn. An eyeball can be manipulated like a marble, such as being rolled or thrown. One can also be affixed to a surface, for example a wall, with 1 minute’s work. An eyeball lasts for 24 hours, and you can maintain a total of three eyeballs at any given time. Creating a fourth destroys the oldest eyeball.

Eyeballs are very small but are easy to spot. A creature actively [Seeking](/action/seek-player-core) or [Searching](/action/search-player-core) automatically finds an eyeball. They’re also not very sturdy and can be destroyed with an [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) action.

name: Orbiting Runestone
descr:
---

You create a runestone that floats around you, and you [Trace a Rune](/action/trace-rune-impossible-magic-action-action-4264) with a damaging invocation on it even if the rune could not normally be applied to an object. The runestone has 10 Hit Points. Each time a creature successfully [Strikes](/action/strike-player-core) you, attempt a DC 11 [flat check](/rule/checks-rules-2278). On a success, the runestone blocks the attack, so the attack first damages the runestone and then applies any remaining damage to you. If this damage reduces the runestone to 0 Hit Points, it explodes outward toward the attacker. If the attacker is within 15 feet, the rune etched upon the runestone invokes automatically, applying its invocation effect to the attacker. The attacker is the only one affected by the invocation, even if the rune could normally affect multiple creatures.

The runestone’s magic is capable of maintaining the traced rune for up to 1 minute as it floats around you, at which point the rune fades and the runestone shatters. You can maintain only a single orbiting rune at any given time. If you try to create a second, the first one shatters.

name: Ostentatious Arrival
descr:
---

All creatures in a 10-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387) around the creature you summoned or manifested except you take 1d4 fire damage per spell rank for a summon or incarnate spell, or 1d4 fire damage per 2 levels for Manifesting your Eidolon. If the creature you summoned or manifested has the [acid](/trait/acid), [cold](/trait/cold), [electricity](/trait/electricity), [fire](/trait/fire), [sonic](/trait/sonic), or [water](/trait/water) trait, the damage is that type instead (or bludgeoning damage for the water trait). If the creature has more than one of these traits, you choose which damage type to deal.

name: Osteo Armaments
descr:
---

If you have bones, you have a weapon. You create a _[+1 striking](/item/striking-gm-core) weapon_ in which you are proficient, made of bone and sinew. If this weapon requires [ammunition](/rule/ammunition-rules-3193), mundane bone ammunition is created when you [reload](/rule/reload-rules-2196) it. The weapon falls apart and is destroyed after 1 hour, if you aren’t holding the weapon at the end of your turn, or if you use this action again, whichever comes first.

At 8th level, you can destroy an adjacent thrall as part of using this action. If you do, the action gains the [thrall](/trait/thrall) trait and the weapon also gains a [_decaying_](/item/decaying-gm-core) rune, or the _greater decaying_ rune if you’re 15th level or higher.

At 10th level, the weapon improves to a _+2 striking weapon_, increasing to a _+2 greater striking weapon_ at 12th level, a _+3 greater striking weapon_ at 16th level, or a _+3 major striking weapon_ at 19th level.

name: Overloaded Ammunition

Be it powder ground from the burnt remains of hippogriff feathers or yarn drawn from the locks of an alicorn, you have these materials at hand and, perhaps more importantly, know how to bend them toward practical effects. These [consumable](/trait/consumable) items can change or enhance the effects of specific spells. To get the most out of a spell catalyst, you or an ally should be able to cast the affected spell.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can make two spell catalysts with an item level no higher than half your level. You must know each spell catalyst’s formula. A spell catalyst created this way is a temporary item and loses its magic the next time you make your [daily preparations](/rule/daily-preparations-rules-2575) if you haven’t already used it.

name: Raise a Tome
descr:
---

You can flip open a book to simultaneously study and deflect attacks. When you [Raise a Shield](/action/raise-a-shield-player-core), you can raise a book you’re wielding instead of a shield. While you have a book raised, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and a +1 circumstance bonus to [Recall Knowledge](/action/recall-knowledge-player-core) checks to identify creatures using a skill related to the subject of the book (Arcana if you’re using your spellbook). If consulting the book normally grants an item bonus to the check for consulting the book, you gain this bonus as well.

If you have [Shield Block](/feat/shield-block-player-core), you can use a raised tome for that feat as though it were a shield. The tome has Hardness 3, HP 12, and BT 6.

In addition, you can inscribe the _reinforcing rune_ into your spellbook to strengthen your tomes, using the same process as [transferring a rune](/rule/transferring-runes-rules-3166). The rune takes the form of a specialized diagram in your spellbook, occupying one page. The rune’s benefits apply to any one tome in your possession chosen during your daily preparations. If your spellbook leaves your possession, the rune-granting benefit is suppressed until you get the book back.

name: Ranged Combatant
descr:
---

Spines, flame jets, and holy blasts are just some of the ways your eidolon might strike from a distance. Your eidolon gains a ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d4 damage and has the [magical](/trait/magical) and [propulsive](/trait/propulsive) traits. When you select this feat, choose a damage type for the attack: [acid](/trait/acid), bludgeoning, [cold](/trait/cold), [electricity](/trait/electricity), [fire](/trait/fire), piercing, slashing, [spirit](/trait/spirit), [vitality](/trait/vitality), or [void](/trait/void).

name: Reach of the Dead
descr:
---

You channel your necrotic magic through a thrall, expending it in the process. If the next action you use is to [Cast a Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) that has range, you cast that spell from one of your thralls within 60 feet. That thrall becomes the point of origin for your spell; calculate range and [cover](/rule/cover-rules-2372) from its space instead of yours. The thrall is then destroyed.

name: Reactive Charm
descr:
**Archetype** [Captivator](/archetype/captivator-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-390)

**Prerequisites**
[Captivator Dedication](/feat/captivator-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9315)

**Trigger**
You are the target of a spell or attack.

---

You’re so charming and distracting that when pressed, you can cast a simple charm in time to foil an attacker. You can cast one of your [innate 1st-rank spells](/rule/innate-spells-rules-2901) with the [mental](/trait/mental) trait that normally takes two actions or fewer to cast as a reaction. This takes effect before the triggering spell or attack, and if the attacker is affected by your spell, it can make different decisions for its attack or spell (for instance, if you charm the attacker, it can choose a different target than you for its attack or spell). The attacking creature must be in range of your chosen spell, and if your spell requires targets, the attacking creature must be a valid target. Your spell affects only the attacking creature, even if it would normally affect more targets or an area.

descr:

---

You can reflexively shift a spell even as it’s being cast. You attempt to Shift the triggering Spell even if you do not meet the other requirements to Shift Spell. After you choose your spellshift, but before you attempt your Arcana check, the caster can voluntarily let their spell be [disrupted](/rule/disrupted-and-lost-spells-rules-2236). Regardless of the outcome, the caster then becomes immune to your Reactive Spellshift for 10 minutes.

name: Recharging Flurry
descr:
**Prerequisites**
twofold tine hybrid study

**Requirements**
You’re wielding two melee weapons, each in a different hand.

---

The clash of steel fuels your magic, preparing you to unleash another magic-infused assault. Make one [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) with each of your weapons, then recharge your [Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260) (regardless of whether the Strikes hit). Your multiple attack penalty increases after each Strike as normal. If the second Strike targets a creature you haven’t attacked yet this turn, its multiple attack penalty is –4 if it’s your second attack this turn (–3 if you’re using an [agile](/trait/agile) weapon) or –8 if it’s your third or further Strike (–6 with an agile weapon).

name: Redirect Spell
descr:
**Archetype** [Spellshifter](/archetype/spellshifter-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-394)

**Prerequisites**
[Spellshifter Dedication](/feat/spellshifter-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9355)

---

You can alter the flow of magic around you, moving a spell effect from one target to another. You gain the Redirect Magic spellshift.

**Spellshift—Redirect Magic** Through sheer force of will, you can direct a spell’s energies away from its caster’s intended target.

**Critical Success** You change a single target of the spell to another viable target within 30 feet of you (even if it would be outside of the spell’s normal range). You can’t use this spellshift to affect a creature twice with the same spell. If the spell had an initial saving throw, the new target must attempt it, possibly achieving a different result than the original target of the spell. The DC for the spell becomes your Arcana DC instead of the original caster’s spell DC.

**Success** As critical success, but if the target succeeds at any required saving throw, they are unaffected, and the spell does not change targets.

name: Redirect Teleportation
descr:
**Trigger**
A creature teleports into a space within 60 feet of you.

---

You’re able to intercept a teleportation effect and change where a creature appears. You expend a prepared spell that has the [teleportation](/trait/teleportation) trait. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the triggering spell. You then attempt to [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-2250) the triggering spell. The counteract rank for this effect is equal to the rank of the expended spell. If you succeed on your counteract check, you don’t [disrupt](/rule/disrupted-and-lost-spells-rules-2236) the spell. Instead, you choose an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you for the creature to teleport into. You can’t choose a space that is obviously harmful (such as into a [_wall of fire_](/spell/wall-of-fire-player-core) or [hazardous terrain](/rule/hazardous-terrain-rules-2587)) or would cause the target to fall.

name: Remote Detonation
descr:
---

You whisper an invocation over your ammunition as you shoot it, and the hissing of the projectile sounds just like your murmured voice. Make a ranged [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) that uses physical ammunition against a target within the first range increment of your weapon. If it hits, you [Invoke Runes](/action/invoke-rune-impossible-magic-action-action-4265) on the target as whisper of the ammunition’s flight sets off the runes. You can invoke up to two runes this way, but all the runes must be on the target of your Strike. On a critical hit, the target takes a –1 circumstance penalty on any saving throws against the runes invoked by your Remote Detonation.

name: Runesmith Dedication
descr:
**Archetype** [Runesmith](/archetype/runesmith-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-388)

**Prerequisites**
Intelligence +2

---

You become trained in [runesmith](/class/runesmith-impossible-magic-class-class-76) [class DC](/rule/class-dc-rules-2051) and Crafting. You gain a runic repertoire with two 1st-level runes of your choice. You choose these from the common runes on the rune list as well as uncommon or rarer runes you have access to.

You can etch runes. An etched rune is carved, inked, or branded; this application does not damage the creature or item. Etching a rune requires an artisan's toolkit. Your magic can sustain up to one etched rune at a time. If you're at least 9th level, increase the maximum number of etched runes you can sustain at a time to 2, and if you're at least 17th level, increase it to 3. You can etch any number of runes up to your maximum during your daily preparations or by spending 10 minutes in exploration mode. Your etched runes remain indefinitely until they're expended or removed or until you etch more runes than your maximum, which causes your oldest rune to fade. Additionally, you gain the Solitary Invocation action.

**Solitary Invocation** **Single Action** ([invocation](/trait/invocation), [magical](/trait/magical), [runesmith](/trait/runesmith)) You utter the name of one of your runes within 30 feet, which blazes with power, applying the effect in its Invocation entry. You become trained in runesmith class DC and Crafting. You gain a runic repertoire with two 1st-level runes of your choice. You choose these from the common runes on the rune list as well as uncommon or rarer runes you have access to.

You can etch runes. An etched rune is carved, inked, or branded; this application does not damage the creature or item. Etching a rune requires an artisan's toolkit. Your magic can sustain up to one etched rune at a time. If you're at least 9th level, increase the maximum number of etched runes you can sustain at a time to 2, and if you're at least 17th level, increase it to 3. You can etch any number of runes up to your maximum during your daily preparations or by spending 10 minutes in exploration mode. Your etched runes remain indefinitely until they're expended or removed or until you etch more runes than your maximum, which causes your oldest rune to fade. Additionally, you gain the Solitary Invocation action.

**Solitary Invocation** **Single Action** (invocation, magical, runesmith) You utter the name of one of your runes within 30 feet, which blazes with power, applying the effect in its Invocation entry. An invoked rune then fades away, its task complete.

name: Runic Correspondence
descr:
**Prerequisites**
Master in Arcana, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion

---

You can write a message that travels long distances at the speed of thought. Once per day, you can take 1 minute to write a message of 25 words or fewer anywhere that can, at least momentarily, hold writing (such as on a piece of parchment, drawn in the sand, or lightly scratched onto soft metal). When you are finished, mentally picture one creature you know well. If the target creature is on the same plane as you, your message appears in their line of sight on any surface that can hold writing. It can be seen by only the target, and the target can read the message even if you don’t share a language. The message disappears once the target reads it, but the creature can respond by spending 1 minute to write their own message of 25 words or fewer in the same way. You instantly receive that message when it is finished, and you can read it even if you don’t share a language.

If you spend 10 minutes writing your message instead, you can include a rune from your runic repertoire. If the target is willing, after reading your message, you Trace the Rune on the target to last for up to 10 minutes. When you receive the creature’s reply, you can Invoke that Rune as a free action.

descr:

name: Sanguine Mastery
descr:
**Prerequisites**

---

Your mastery over the intricacies of your fascination has allowed you to infuse your own blood with additional healing properties while increasing your ability to bleed out any foes that stand against you. You gain [resistance](/rule/resistance-rules-2318) to [bleed](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core) damage equal to half your level. Additionally, if an enemy within 30 feet of you is bleeding, you gain [fast healing](/rule/fast-healing-and-regeneration-rules-2322) equal to half your level. This fast healing is deactivated while you have the [dying](/condition/dying-player-core) condition.

In addition, whenever you destroy a thrall, a creature adjacent to the thrall takes 1 persistent bleed damage. If that creature is already taking bleed damage, instead increase its bleed damage by 1. A creature can have its bleed damage increased in this way only once per round.

name: Seek the Hidden Glyphs
descr:
---

You are well-versed in the use of magical runes in traps and hazards. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [Perception](/rule/perception-rules-3303) checks to find magical traps. Even if you aren’t [Searching](/action/search-player-core), you get a check to find magical traps that normally require you to be Searching. You still need to meet any other requirements to find the trap. As long as you are holding or wearing an [artisan’s toolkit](/item/artisan-s-toolkit-player-core), you can use Crafting instead of Thievery to disable a magical trap, treating your proficiency in Crafting as your proficiency in Thievery for requirements.

In addition, if you trigger a trap by critically failing a check to Disable it, you can [Trace a Rune](/action/trace-rune-impossible-magic-action-action-4264) on yourself as a reaction, gaining the benefits of the rune before the trap affects you.

The shield appears in the book as an elaborate bookmark. The fusion lasts until you fuse a shield into a new book or the book is out of your possession for 24 hours. While the two are fused, the book shares the Hardness, Hit Points, and Broken Threshold of the shield. The fused item has the shield’s activations and benefits (such as a [_spellguard shield_](/item/spellguard-shield-gm-core)’s bonus to saving throws against magic), and it can still be consulted as normal for purposes like [Recall Knowledge](/action/recall-knowledge-player-core) and the benefits of Raise a Tome. If the shield or your spellbook is etched with a _reinforcing rune_, the fused item gains the rune while they’re fused; if both have the rune, the highest-level rune applies.

You are [unholy](/trait/unholy).

---

You attempt to steal the soul of a creature that was at least 18th level that died within the last minute. Attempt an Occultism check against the hard DC of the [target’s level](/rule/level-based-dcs-rules-2629). On a success, you capture its soul and solidify it into a gem that keeps the soul contained. While the soul is contained, it can’t be returned to life through any means, even powerful magic such as the [_wish_](/ritual/wish-player-core) ritual. If a gem is destroyed, the soul is freed, and you become alerted to its destruction. You can maintain only three gems at any given time. If you attempt to make a fourth, you must choose a soul to be released.

You can consume a captured soul by swallowing a gem. Doing so grants you the unholy and [undead](/trait/undead) traits and extends your existence by 50 years. You gain void healing, you aren’t instantly destroyed when reduced to 0 Hit Points, and you can’t be instantly killed by [death effects](/rule/death-effects-rules-2331). If you’re destroyed, you can rebuild yourself in the location of one of your soul gems. This consumes the gem, and it takes 24 hours for your body to be rebuilt. If you are ever destroyed and are unable to rebuild your body, all souls that you have consumed are released.

name: Soulforger Dedication
descr:
**Archetype** [Soulforger](/archetype/soulforger-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-393)

**Prerequisites**
 or ability to cast divine spells

---

You can manifest the power of your spirit in combat to realize your motivations. You bind a suit of armor, shield, or weapon as a [soulforged armament](/rule/binding-an-armament-impossible-magic-rules-rules-3690). Choose a motivation or cause known as a soul path (page 101) that ties you to your soulforged armament; acting against or ignoring your soul path is anathema to you and could lead you to be afflicted with a curse called [soulforged corruption](/rule/corruption-impossible-magic-rules-rules-3693). Choose one essence power for the armament (see archetype). Changing an essence power requires 1 week of retraining, and you can’t retrain them while you have soulforged corruption.

You can Manifest Soulforged Armament to summon your soulforged armaments in combat.

**Manifest Soulforged Armament** **Single Action** ([concentrate](/trait/concentrate), [divine](/trait/divine), [extradimensional](/trait/extradimensional)) **Requirements** If summoning a soulforged weapon or shield, you have the hands free to wield it; if summoning soulforged armor, you aren’t wearing any armor; **Effect** You immediately wield or wear the soulforged armament bound to you. The soulforged armament remains manifested until you [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) this effect.

Once per day when you use this ability, you can manifest the armament’s essence form. You gain the armament’s essence power until it’s Dismissed. After 1 minute, the essence form armament is automatically Dismissed.

name: Spatial Awareness
descr:
---

Your study of different planes of existence makes you more attuned to teleportation effects. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus when you attempt to [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-2250) a [teleportation](/trait/teleportation) effect.

When a teleportation effect occurs within 60 feet of you, you detect the location of the effect as a [precise sense](/rule/precise-senses-rules-2406). If the effect is a creature teleporting away from that space, you know the general direction of the location to which it teleported but not the distance. However, you can attempt to [Identify Magic](/action/identify-magic-player-core) within an hour of the teleportation to know the location to which the creature teleported within 10 miles on a success or 1 mile on a critical success.

name: Speak with Days Long Dead
descr:
---

You channel the essences and echoes of spirits long dead that reside within a location, an object, or a bloodline. You spend 10 minutes and must be within the location, be able to touch a piece of the object, or drink a drop of blood of the bloodline as appropriate to the spirits you wish to channel. You learn one piece of information or about one significant event relating directly to the location, object, or bloodline that has occurred within the last year. You can channel any given target only once every 24 hours.

At 12th level, you can learn about information or events that took place within the last decade, within the last century if you are 16th level, or at any point in history at 20th level.

name: Spell Crash
descr:
**Prerequisites**
Your [Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260) is charged, and you have at least one spell prepared in a spell slot.

---

Instead of blending a spell into an attack, you can funnel the spell’s magic into a pure blast that expands out from you. You smash your weapon or fist into the ground and expend a spell prepared in one of your spell slots. The magic of the spell explodes out in your choice of a 20-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387), 30-foot [cone](/rule/cone-rules-2386), or 60-foot [line](/rule/line-rules-2388). Each creature in the area takes 1d10 force damage per spell rank of the expended spell, with a [basic](/rule/basic-saving-throws-rules-2297) Reflex save against your spell DC. If your weapon has the [shove](/trait/shove) trait, you push any creature that fails its save 10 feet; if your weapon has the [trip](/trait/trip) trait, any creature that fails its save falls prone. Your Spellstrike is no longer charged.

If the spell you expended could deal a type of damage other than force, you can change the explosion’s damage to that type and replace Spell Crash’s [force](/trait/force) trait with the corresponding trait.

name: Spell Swipe
descr:
**Prerequisites**
[Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260)

**Requirements**
Your Spellstrike is charged.

---

You attack in an arc and enact your spell against everyone you hit. Make a Spellstrike, but roll separate [Strikes](/action/strike-player-core) to attack two creatures, each of whom must be within your melee reach and adjacent to each other. If your spell could affect two or more targets or would normally have an area, your spell affects whichever foes you hit, not just the first target; otherwise, choose one target to affect with the spell. As Spellstrike, Spell Swipe counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after you make both attacks.

If you’re using a weapon that has the [sweep](/trait/sweep) trait, its circumstance bonus applies against both targets. You can use this activity with only melee Strikes, even if you have the starlit span hybrid study or a similar ability.

If you use [Expansive Spellstrike](/feat/expansive-spellstrike-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9047) to Spellstrike with an area spell, apply the area as described in Expansive Spellstrike, choosing one of the two targets to determine the area.

name: Spellshifter Dedication
descr:
**Archetype** [Spellshifter](/archetype/spellshifter-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-394)

**Prerequisites**
Trained in Arcana

---

You can exert your will over magical spells cast in your vicinity, potentially altering or controlling their effects. You accomplish this through the use of a spellshifting conduit, a magical object of your choice that has light Bulk and can be held in one hand. If your conduit is lost or destroyed, you can train yourself to use a new one by spending 10 minutes attuning yourself to it. You gain the Shift Spell action and the Share the Burden spellshift.

**Shift Spell** **Single Action** ([concentrate](/trait/concentrate), [manipulate](/trait/manipulate)) **Requirements** You are within the affected area of an ongoing spell, or you can physically touch an object or creature under the effects of a spell, and you are holding your conduit; **Effect** Choose a spellshift and attempt an Arcana check against the DC of the spell (or the spell DC of the spellcaster if the spell does not normally have a DC). The caster immediately becomes aware that you’re trying to shift their spell and intuitively knows the potential effects of the shift, but not the result of your skill check. A willing caster can allow you to achieve one degree of success higher than the result of your check. The effects of the check are dependent on the chosen spellshift. Regardless of the result, the spell becomes immune to Shift Spell for 24 hours.

**Spellshift—Shift Burden** You share the burden of a spell, allowing you to share control with the caster. If [Sustaining](/action/sustain-player-core) a spell with this spellshift causes a creature to attempt a saving throw, it is attempted against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the spell requires a spell attack roll, make the attack using your Arcana modifier instead of the spell’s normal spell attack modifier.

**Critical Success** If the spell is sustainable, you can Sustain the spell as a free action as though you had cast the spell. For the remainder of the spell’s duration, you can Sustain the spell as though you were the caster.

**Success** If the spell is sustainable, you can Sustain the spell as a free action as though you had cast the spell.

## Spellshifter Dedication leads to...

[Analyze Magic](/feat/analyze-magic-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9356), [Dismantle Spell](/feat/dismantle-spell-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9359), [Elemental Subsitution](/feat/elemental-subsitution-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9357), [Enhance Spell](/feat/enhance-spell-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9361), [Reactive Spellshift](/feat/reactive-spellshift-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9360), [Redirect Spell](/feat/redirect-spell-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9362), [Subtle Shift](/feat/subtle-shift-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9358)

name: Spirit Sheath
descr:
---

You’ve magically constructed an extradimensional sheath for your weapon that you access through your clothing, typically through a pocket, sleeve, or seam. This sheath is hard to notice, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks to Conceal an Item within it. A spirit sheath can hold up to 1 Bulk worth of weapons.

During a [Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260), you can [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) to draw one weapon from the sheath before you [Cast the Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core). You can draw or return a weapon to a spirit sheath as an Interact action, as can anyone else holding or wearing the clothing that contains the sheath. A [_dispel magic_](/spell/dispel-magic-player-core) spell or similar effect can be used against the spirit sheath to expel the weapon. The [counteract](/rule/counteracting-rules-2250) check is made against your spell DC and the counteract rank is half your level rounded up. The weapon is also expelled if you become [unconscious](/condition/unconscious-player-core).

Starlight shines in your sight, enhancing your perception and range. When you make a ranged Strike, you lower the DC of your flat check to target a creature that’s concealed or hidden from you. The DC is reduced to 4 instead of 5 against a concealed creature and to 10 instead of 11 against a hidden one. If you’re in Arcane Cascade stance, you instead reduce the DC to 3 against a concealed creature or 9 against a hidden one.

You are not overflowing.

---

Your internal nexus has grown to an immense size and can absorb workings of magic even as they form, sometimes even swallowing them entirely. You become overflowing as if you had Absorbed Magic. If you completely mitigate the damage to a creature, the triggering spell or ability has no effect on them.

The amount of damage reduced increases by 1d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

name: Steed Form
descr:
---

Your eidolon changes to make them particularly effective as your mount. While you ride them, you get your full number of actions each round instead of reducing them to 2. This applies only when you ride your eidolon, not when anyone else does (see the Riding Sapient Creatures sidebar). Your eidolon still must be at least one size category larger than you to ride them. Since you work together to move, your eidolon’s move actions while you’re mounted gain the [tandem](/trait/tandem) trait.

## Riding Sapient Creatures

 Riding along on a sapient creature that isn’t a minion requires a lot of coordination and timing. Both the riding creature and the mount regain only 2 actions at the start of their turns each round, as both the mount and the riding creature interfere with one another’s actions. If you ride your eidolon, you reduce your total actions to 2 and continue to share actions normally—you don’t reduce the number of actions twice.

name: Stolen Spell
descr:
**Frequency**
once per 10 minutes

**Trigger**
You critically succeed at a saving throw against an enemy’s spell, or an enemy critically fails a spell attack roll against you.

---

As you perfectly counter a spell, you re-aim its magic to use it yourself. You gain the ability to cast the triggering spell one time before the end of your next turn, even if it’s not on your spell list or is of a higher rank than you can cast. This doesn’t cost you a spell slot or other resource. If you cast it as part of a [Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260) against the creature that originally cast it, that creature is [off-guard](/condition/off-guard-player-core) against your [Strike](/action/strike-player-core). Use your own spellcasting statistics for this spell, as you do for other spells you cast.

name: Stone Forge of the First
descr:
**Frequency**
once per day

---

You conjure forth a massive stone forge within 30 feet that occupies a 15-foot cube in empty spaces on the ground. The forge lasts for 1 minute before crumbling into dust. The forge amplifies the power of runes in a 60-foot [emanation](/rule/emanation-rules-2387). The duration of a traced rune doesn’t elapse while it’s within the emanation but resumes once the rune is outside the emanation. Additionally, runes invoked within the forge’s emanation don’t fade, but instead become faint. Faint runes maintain their passive benefits but can’t be invoked again.

name: Striker's Scroll
descr:
**Prerequisites**
[Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260)

---

You can attach a [scroll](/trait/scroll) to your weapon or [_handwraps of mighty blows_](/item/handwraps-of-mighty-blows-gm-core) to blend its spell into an attack, carefully folding it around a part of the weapon or sealing it to the weapon’s surface. Attaching a scroll requires using the [Affix a Talisman](/action/affix-a-talisman-gm-core) action. You can have only one scroll affixed to a weapon at a time, and you can’t have both a talisman and scroll attached.

You can [Cast the Spell](/action/cast-a-spell-player-core) from the scroll as part of a Spellstrike, provided the spell is one you could normally use with Spellstrike. You can’t Cast the Spell in any other way while it’s affixed, though you can use Affix a Talisman again to remove the scroll and use it as a normal—if a bit crumpled—scroll.

name: Student of the Staff
descr:
**Prerequisites**
twisting tree hybrid study

---

You’ve studied the [staff](/item/staff-player-core) extensively to learn the hidden capabilities of your chosen weapon. When you critically succeed at an attack roll using a staff, you can apply the [critical specialization](/rule/critical-specialization-rules-2203) effect of the [club](/item/club-player-core) group. (If you use the critical specialization on a [Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260), the spell still affects the target even if you pushed the target out of reach.)

While you’re in [Arcane Cascade](/action/arcane-cascade-impossible-magic-action-action-4261) stance, your staff gains the [deadly d6](/trait/deadly) trait, with the damage from the deadly die being the same damage type as the extra damage from Arcane Cascade.

In addition, you can place [property runes](/rule/property-runes-rules-3168) into a magic staff you prepare, even though a magic staff can’t typically hold property runes. You must first inscribe the property runes into your spellbook, using the same process as [transferring a rune](/rule/transferring-runes-rules-3166). The rune takes the form of a specialized diagram in your spellbook, occupying one page. You can’t inscribe runes that can’t be placed on a non-magical staff, nor can you inscribe the [_shifting_](/item/shifting-gm-core) rune. When you prepare a staff, you can impart any number of property runes from your spellbook into the staff, up to the limit imposed by the staff’s _weapon potency_ rune.

name: Summoner Dedication
descr:
**Archetype** [Summoner](/archetype/summoner-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-389)

**Prerequisites**
Charisma +2

---

You’ve formed a bond with an eidolon, an entity that manifests in a physical body only through their link to your life force. You gain an eidolon as well as the [Manifest Eidolon](/action/manifest-eidolon-impossible-magic-action-action-4267) activity. Due to your tenuous link, you can’t gain or use [tandem](/trait/tandem) actions. Because you don’t have [Act Together](/action/act-together-impossible-magic-action-action-4268), only you or your eidolon can perform an [exploration](/rule/exploration-rules-2006) activity at one time.

Your eidolon is trained in unarmed attacks and unarmored defense, and shares your proficiency rank for [Perception](/rule/perception-rules-2040), saving throws, and skill checks. Choose an eidolon type. You become trained in your eidolon’s listed skills. For each of those skills that you’re already trained in, you become trained in a different skill of your choice. Your eidolon’s initial attributes are reduced. Instead of starting with a +4 attribute modifier in Strength or Dexterity and +2 in the other, your eidolon starts with a +3 in Strength or Dexterity and +2 in the other attribute. They otherwise gain the statistics listed for an eidolon of that type.

At 5th level, the eidolon’s attribute modifier that was reduced to +3 increases to +4, before applying attribute boosts. At levels 5, 10, 15, and 20, your eidolon also gets four attribute boosts, which follow the same rules as yours.

## Summoner Dedication leads to...

[Basic Summoner Spellcasting](/feat/basic-summoner-spellcasting-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9308), [Basic Synergy](/feat/basic-synergy-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9309), [Expert Combat Eidolon](/feat/expert-combat-eidolon-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9312), [Initial Eidolon Ability](/feat/initial-eidolon-ability-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9310)

name: Surprising Leap
descr:
---

Your eidolon jumps into the air to attack a foe. Your eidolon makes a [Leap](/action/leap-player-core), [High Jump](/action/high-jump-player-core), or [Long Jump](/action/long-jump-player-core) and attempts one melee [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) at any point during that jump. Immediately after the Strike, your eidolon falls to the ground if they’re in the air, even if they haven’t reached the maximum distance of their jump. If the distance your eidolon falls is no more than the height of their jump, your eidolon takes no damage and lands upright.

When attempting a High Jump or Long Jump during a Surprising Leap, determine the jump distance using Long Jump’s rules, and change your eidolon’s maximum distance to double their Speed.

**Prerequisites**
You aren’t [unholy](/trait/unholy).

---

While many necromancers seek unholy and perverse power, you have dedicated yourself to the practice of necromancy to stop the creation of permanent undead and the corruption of souls. You and your thralls gain the [holy](/trait/holy) trait. Strikes your thralls make gain the holy trait and deal 1 additional [spirit](/trait/spirit) damage. This additional spirit damage increases to 2 at 10th level. You also gain the following anathema: “purposefully create undead to do undue harm.”

name: The Taste of Magic
descr:
**Archetype** [Living Nexus](/archetype/living-nexus-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-392)

**Prerequisites**
[Living Nexus Dedication](/feat/living-nexus-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9338)

---

Each working of magic has a unique scent and frequency of vibration. You have trained yourself to recognize the minute differences in magics, as if distinguishing between different odors. You gain [scent](/rule/scent-rules-3375) as an [imprecise sense](/rule/imprecise-senses-rules-2407) with a range of 30 feet. This scent can only detect creatures, items, and effects that are currently under the effect of a spell or have the [arcane](/trait/arcane), [divine](/trait/divine), [magical](/trait/magical), [occult](/trait/occult), or [primal](/trait/primal) trait. In addition, you may use Arcana, Occultism, Nature, or Religion instead of Survival to [Track](/action/track-player-core) creatures you could sense with this ability.
