name: The World Devours
descr:
**Archetype** [World Rouser](/archetype/world-rouser-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-396)

**Prerequisites**
[World Rouser Dedication](/feat/world-rouser-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9376)

**Requirements**
Your waking world is active.

---

The ground in your waking world opens to consume a creature standing on it, which must attempt a Reflex save against your world rouser DC. The creature must be Medium or smaller; if your waking world is a 20-foot [burst](/rule/burst-rules-2385), the creature can be Large or smaller, or Huge or smaller if your waking world is a 30-foot burst or larger. If you use this ability while your waking world already has a creature [grabbed](/condition/grabbed-player-core) or devoured, that creature is automatically freed. If your waking world ends, any creature affected by this ability is automatically freed.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage.

**Failure** The creature takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is grabbed by the earth. The creature can attempt to [Escape](/action/escape-player-core) against your world rouser DC.

**Critical Failure** The creature is pulled into the earth, which closes above it. It takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage immediately and is devoured. While devoured, it becomes grabbed and [slowed](/condition/slowed-player-core) 1, and takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage at the end of each of its turns, and cannot be targeted by any effect. A creature can attempt to Escape against your world rouser DC; in addition to the normal checks to Escape, it can attempt a [Nature](/domain/nature) check. If it Escapes, it is returned to the area where it was when grabbed. A creature with a [burrow Speed](/rule/burrow-speed-rules-2348) can Escape automatically and move up to its burrow Speed as part of that action.

name: Twin Eidolon
descr:
---

You can transform to match your eidolon. When you Manifest your Eidolon, you can call upon their powers to transform yourself into a duplicate until your eidolon unmanifests. You can’t use this if you Manifest your Eidolon in an unusual way, such as [Meld into Eidolon](/feat/meld-into-eidolon-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9227). While using Twin Eidolon, you use your eidolon’s statistics other than your own Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma attribute modifiers, including their evolutions. You can’t cast spells (except spells your eidolon could cast), Activate or otherwise benefit from magic items that normally benefit you and not your eidolon, or use other actions they can’t perform. Any of their spells you cast with limited uses count against your eidolon’s uses. You can Manifest your Eidolon again to end this effect.

**Special** This feat has the trait matching your eidolon’s tradition ([arcane](/trait/arcane), [divine](/trait/divine), [occult](/trait/occult), or [primal](/trait/primal)).

name: Undead Familiar
descr:
---

You gain the ability to raise an undead familiar who will serve you as your loyal and sometimes expendable partner as you explore your necromantic magic. You gain a familiar. It has the [undead](/trait/undead) trait instead of the [animal](/trait/animal) trait and is immune to [bleed](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core), [death effects](/rule/death-effects-rules-2331), [disease](/trait/disease), [mental](/trait/mental), and [poison](/trait/poison). You can choose only one familiar ability per day for this familiar instead of two, and you can’t choose an ability that changes the creature’s trait (such as construct or dragon). Additionally, this familiar can be targeted by spells and abilities that target your thralls. If you destroy your familiar, you can raise them back to undeath during your next daily preparations.

name: Versatile Spellstrike
descr:
**Prerequisites**
[Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260)

---

You can channel the entire realm of possibilities of your spellbook into an attack. Once during your daily preparations, you can use a spell slot to hold that infinite potential, rather than using it to prepare a spell. When you make a Spellstrike, you can expend this special spell slot to immediately prepare and cast a spell from your spellbook at 2 ranks lower than the slot’s rank. (As normal for preparing spells, you can use a spell of an even lower rank, heightening it accordingly.) You don’t have any spell prepared in that slot until you cast from that slot.

name: Vital Compound Invocation
descr:

You [Invoke two Runes](/action/invoke-rune-impossible-magic-action-action-4265)—one must be a divine rune, and one must be a primal rune. name: Wake and Tremble
descr:

**Prerequisites**
[World Rouser Dedication](/feat/world-rouser-dedication-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9376)

**Trigger**
You Rouse the World.

---

You have the world wake with a great convulsion. All other creatures in the area when you Rouse the World must attempt a Reflex save against your world rouser DC.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature falls and lands [prone](/condition/prone-player-core).

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature also becomes [sickened](/condition/sickened-player-core) 1.

name: Whirlwind Spell
descr:
**Prerequisites**
[Spellstrike](/action/spellstrike-impossible-magic-action-action-4260)

**Requirements**
Your Spellstrike is charged.

---

You combine the might of a multitarget spell with a whirling flurry of attacks. You use Spellstrike, making a melee [Strike](/action/strike-player-core) against each enemy within your reach instead of against one enemy. If your spell can affect multiple targets or normally has an area, your spell affects all foes you hit, not just the first target, up to the spell’s normal maximum targets. If you Strike more enemies than the spell could target, choose which foes are affected by the spell. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty but doesn’t increase your penalty until you’ve made all your attacks.

You can use this activity with only melee Strikes, even if you have the starlit span hybrid study or a similar ability.

If you use [Expansive Spellstrike](/feat/expansive-spellstrike-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9047) to Spellstrike with an area spell, apply the area as described in Expansive Spellstrike, choosing one of the targets to determine the area.

name: World Rouser Dedication
descr:
**Archetype** [World Rouser](/archetype/world-rouser-impossible-magic-archetype-archetype-396)

**Prerequisites**
Trained in Nature

---

You know how to wake the world around you from its slumber, whether through your natural affinity for nature or hard-earned knowledge. You gain the Rouse the World action.

As your ability to converse with the world grows, you can call on it to help you in other ways, some of which require a saving throw. The DC for an ability gained via this archetype is either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is called your world rouser DC.

**Rouse the World** **Single Action** ([concentrate](/trait/concentrate), [primal](/trait/primal)) The flora, fauna, and elements in a 10- foot burst within 30 feet stir, aiding you and your allies and whispering in your ear. This area is known as your waking world. While in your waking world, you and your allies gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics and Acrobatics checks, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Nature checks to [Recall Knowledge](/action/recall-knowledge-player-core) about creatures and hazards in the area. The effect lasts for 10 minutes, but you can [Dismiss](/action/dismiss-player-core) it. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) this ability to increase the burst’s size by 10 feet. You can Rouse the World in only one area at a time; if you use this ability again, the first area returns to normal.

## World Rouser Dedication leads to...

[A Hush Falls Over the World](/feat/a-hush-falls-over-the-world-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9383), [All Returns to Slumber](/feat/all-returns-to-slumber-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9379), [Awake With a Roar](/feat/awake-with-a-roar-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9386), [Come in From the Wilderness](/feat/come-in-from-the-wilderness-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9384), [Dust Cloud](/feat/dust-cloud-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9381), [Nature's Embrace](/feat/nature-s-embrace-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9377), [Sheltering Hand](/feat/sheltering-hand-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9380), [The World Devours](/feat/the-world-devours-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9385), [The World Whispers](/feat/the-world-whispers-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9378), [Wake and Tremble](/feat/wake-and-tremble-impossible-magic-feat-feat-9382)

name: Writing on the Wall
descr:
**Prerequisites**
Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion

---

You place hidden messages written in a runic cipher of your devising. You can cast [_embed message_](/spell/embed-message-player-core) once per day as an [innate spell](/rule/innate-spells-rules-2232). The rank of this spell is equal to half your level, rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least expert in the related skill (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, and Religion for divine). When you cast _embed message_, instead of choosing a language you know for the message’s text and speech, you can choose to have the message be text only, written in a runic code that only you know. You can impart the knowledge of this code to up to 5 creatures over the course of 10 minutes; they retain this knowledge indefinitely, but you can devise a new runic code for subsequent messages you wish to be encoded.

A creature can Decipher the Writing of your runic code using the same skill associated with the chosen tradition against your class DC.
